reason: I'd try the free version for a week, but I won't keep scanning receipts and logging what I buy and use. Our helper does a lot of the cooking, so I'm not the one in the kitchen planning meals, and I don't see her using an app either.
objection: I won't keep logging every item I buy and use. If it only works when I feed it receipts, it'll be empty and wrong within two weeks, and my helper won't maintain it.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that receipt scanning is truly one tap and accurate in Arabic on Gulf supermarket receipts, and that my helper can use it in her own language without me.
